one_star_reviews.text:
We rented the 4/1 drugstore apartment from August 15th to 22nd, 2026. The apartment was spacious, very well-equipped (even for the beach), and well-located. However, the apartment was dirty upon our arrival (a broken tooth in a bedroom drawer, a clogged shower, dust everywhere). We cleaned everything upon our departure for the next tenants. Regarding the rental agency, they provide no information upon arrival, simply hand over the keys and leave you to fend for yourself. No inventory is taken, there's no Wi-Fi as promised, and no notes are provided about the apartment. I called to get the Wi-Fi code and am still waiting for a response from the agency, to whom I sent an email upon arrival regarding the condition of the apartment.
Remember to take photos upon arrival.

one_star_reviews.text:
I went into that store for the first time. I bought a bag online and the leather is peeling. I contacted the brand via WhatsApp and they directed me to a physical store, the closest one in Ourense. A very arrogant blonde woman helped me. She asked me to email her the receipt or print it out and bring it to her. I told her I wasn't from there and she started huffing and puffing. She said the bag wasn't going to stay there, that she needed to take some photos and they would assess it. I said okay, but that it would be better if I could email her the tag. Then she disappeared and another woman helped me who was much nicer. I was with my baby, my partner, and my mother-in-law, and it seemed the first woman was bothered by so many people or by the baby in particular.
I don't know if I'll have to go back, but I just hope I don't have to exchange a word with her.

one_star_reviews.text: Terrible service. The funeral was 45 minutes late without any prior notice. We had to ask at reception several times. After the service, we had to personally call reception again to have the coffin removed, as no one answered the priest's call. In total, there was a one-hour delay, even though they are the ones who set the funeral times for a service that isn't free. It would be so easy to apologize when you realize you can't provide the service you've agreed to.

Terrible service due to a clear lack of staff. It seems (according to what we were told) that the same person coordinates the viewing rooms, the burials, the lowering of the coffin for cremation, and everything else. This obvious lack of staff affects families, forcing them to wait for the contracted services to be provided, and even delaying them. For example, someone who died at 4:00 AM should have their service first thing the next morning, but in our case, they scheduled the service for 12:15 PM (which was already late), and we also had to wait until approximately 1:00 PM because the person coordinating the viewing rooms was also coordinating a burial at the same time. To make matters worse, after the prayer service, when the priest pressed the button to lower the coffin, it didn't come down because it was surely the same person who had to be there, and logically, they couldn't handle all the tasks. PLEASE SHOW SOME RESPECT for the families during these difficult times, especially considering that it is not a cheap service.

The funeral home itself is fine, the rooms and spaces are nice, but the service has been terrible. When it was time for the funeral service, no one showed up, and 45 minutes later, they excused themselves by saying there had been a delay. The problem is that there's only one person responsible for organizing the service, and then accompanying the previous family to arrange the burial. The next family can't start until that one is finished. The family waited 45 minutes without anyone coming to tell them anything, and only after going to reception several times did they admit that there's only one person to do everything, and they were with the other family. To top it all off, we also had to go to reception to ask them to take the coffin down for cremation because no one was answering there either.

one_star_reviews.text:
It's deplorable that there's no cafeteria. In a moment of such profound grief, when you spend hours there, there aren't even the most basic amenities to make those moments a little more comfortable—something to eat, a coffee, a cup of herbal tea. They settle for vending machines that, as happened this week, can be broken or out of service for days. Not to mention the state and filth of the walls in some rooms, with unpainted or poorly painted finishes. Sometimes I wonder where our taxes go and if the presence of the Alcalá de Henares City Council on its Board of Directors is worth anything.

And even more deplorable is the standard response they give to all the negative reviews... well... they take note internally and everything will continue as before. I don't know what's worse: that they don't respond at all, or that they give the same response to everything... 🤦🏼‍♀️

A disaster. No cafeteria, no remote control for the air conditioning. Full of insects that I don't quite understand where they came from. No snacks to take a proper break. In short, from bad to worse.

On August 13th, we were holding a wake for our uncle, and these situations are difficult enough as it is, but the lack of air conditioning on that intensely hot day on the peninsula made it even harder. The cafeteria had been closed for years due to a failed bidding process, although I'd say it's all about money, and to top it all off, the water vending machines were empty. These things certainly make such a moment much more difficult.

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with the company during the training process has been truly disappointing and, above all, has left me with a significant lack of transparency and professionalism.

During today's training, someone I believe to be from human resources entered the classroom, asked to speak with the instructor for a few minutes, and upon returning, told me and another colleague that we had to go home. This was done without prior notice and without any prior communication regarding any issues with our performance.

I asked three times what the specific reason for the decision was and received no clear explanation. The only thing I was told was that they "believed" we wouldn't pass the training and that, for this reason, it was best if we left as soon as possible.
What has disappointed me most is not that the company decides not to continue in a program. That can happen and is perfectly respectable. What I find unacceptable is the way they handled it and the complete lack of explanation. After attending the training, dedicating my time and effort, and committing to the process, I believe I deserved at least to know why that decision was made.

Furthermore, I want to emphasize that my instructor was always very approachable, respectful, and professional throughout the training. The decision came from outside the classroom.
This experience, due to the way it was handled, has left me with a very negative impression of the company.

One star. A terrible experience, from the furniture assembler to the marble workers, who finally finished it after a month and a half. I don't know how they can work like that, honestly. Even before I had anything installed, the marble worker's slow pace was unbelievable. He was late and did a terrible job. The man who initially helped me, Erik, was very friendly, but after I gave him the first deposit, he completely ignored me. He was always busy with other clients. When I told him I didn't think he was professional because he was ignoring my messages, he got offended and refused to help me anymore. He passed it on to his colleague Nerea, who also didn't understand the order and wasn't any more professional than him. Basically, between one thing and another, it took a month and a half to finish, and even then, it wasn't a perfect finish. I can't go into all the details, as there were quite a few, and this review would be very long. But I absolutely DO NOT recommend them to ANYONE. Neither the people who help you are professional, and the furniture assemblers and marble workers are even less so. I deeply regret having my kitchen done with them. Despite hearing bad experiences... I didn't pay attention, thinking it wasn't true. I'm sorry to post this review, but we're so fed up! I want people to know how they operate. I know they've changed staff, and it's gotten worse and worse. I don't know how to send photos so you can see the problems, but according to them... that's how it is. Their response is outrageous.

Responding to your reply to my review, I understand you wanted to make yourself look good, but I won't allow it by twisting my review. I'm the one who changed things during the process because you know it's not true.

The entire process has been a complete disaster, from the very beginning when they arrived two hours late to assemble the furniture... to the very end. According to you, the finish isn't right because the materials are different and it's not uniform. This is something Erik, with his professionalism, advised my husband and me about in the store, providing a quote that included everything, and after we made the first payment. NOTHING HAS BEEN CHANGED during the entire process. There has been a lack of communication, a lack of interest, and a lack of professionalism on everyone's part. As I said before... it's been a complete fiasco! I've never disrespected anyone, but I have spoken frankly, because enough is enough! One mistake after another... you are INCOMPETENT. Regarding finalizing the payment, since you mentioned it, I have no problem completing it as soon as the work is finished properly.
Best regards!

one_star_reviews.text:
This company is a complete DISASTER. Their "customer service" DOESN'T WORK. After an incident at a locker in Sabadell, after putting a package in for return to Amazon, I closed the locker and THEN it said "package not recognized"!!! My desperation began trying to contact Pudo to report the incident and see how I could retrieve my package (a watch worth €240) from inside the locker.
IMPOSSIBLE. 39 CALLS, URGENT EMAILS TO CUSTOMER SERVICE. NOTHING AT ALL.
I didn't leave the laundromat until they came to pick up the package, Pudo called me, or a miracle happened. The miracle happened after 2 hours when another customer came in to drop off a package, and with their code, my locker opened and I was able to retrieve my watch!!!!
I never received a single call or email showing any interest in the matter. Damn inefficiency.

I'm from Sabadell, Barcelona. I went to use a locker to return an Amazon product, and the locker told me they couldn't make the delivery, but they wouldn't let me open the door under any circumstances. The locker kept my package. I've sent emails and called the contact number at different times, but no one answers. The problem definitely isn't the locker itself, because I understand that technology can fail. The real problem is the terrible customer service, the inability to resolve the issue, and simply having to accept that the locker stole my package and there's no one to help me. This service is awful. I'm giving it one star because I can't give it any or take it away.

one_star_reviews.text:
Good afternoon. I want to express my deep unease and disappointment with the state of the Camas library and, especially, with the usual response given to those of us who complain that it's practically impossible to study there: being directed to the study room in the Multifunctional Building as if it were a suitable and fully equipped alternative.

To those who always respond with such pride that "we have a study room," I sincerely invite them to spend a whole morning there and try to study and concentrate for several hours. Conversations, shouts, laughter, and other noises are constantly audible, both from outside and from within the building itself. The room lacks adequate soundproofing and doesn't even have a door that can be closed to minimally block out the noise. It's not a matter of demanding perfect facilities, but rather that a space intended for study should actually allow for studying.

The furniture is also unsuitable for a study room. The tables and chairs are very different from one another and are in quite poor condition, giving the impression that they were repurposed from old schools or offices. Some chairs are also in a state of clear need for improvement in terms of cleanliness.

Another significant problem is the distribution of electrical outlets. While there are outlets, they are only located on the walls, with none in the central area of ​​the room. This means that people using the central tables cannot plug in a computer or other devices, a basic necessity in any study space these days. Therefore, even though there are outlets, their placement makes many of the tables impractical for those who need to use them.

The lighting is also inadequate for studying for several hours. It doesn't seem designed for a room specifically intended for study and can be uncomfortable for reading and working for extended periods.

Furthermore, there is no water fountain in the room, a basic requirement considering that students are expected to be there for hours. The bathroom conditions are also subpar: on occasion, it's practically pitch black to enter and use a mobile phone flashlight because the lighting is not working properly.

Therefore, I believe it's important to point out that having a room doesn't necessarily mean having a suitable study room. A study room should, at a minimum, offer reasonable conditions of quiet, lighting, cleanliness, comfort, maintenance, and practical access to electrical outlets.

I'm not writing this review based on a single experience. I have photos and videos of the facilities and the noise levels on different days and at different times, so you can objectively verify what I'm describing.

I find it especially disappointing that, in response to student complaints, the answer is simply to tell us that "we have a study room," without considering whether it actually meets the necessary conditions for that purpose.

I invite anyone who thinks this space is adequate to spend just one morning there, try to study for several hours, use a computer, and personally check the noise, the lighting, the distribution of the electrical outlets, the condition of the furniture, and the other issues mentioned.

I sincerely hope that this situation is taken into account and that real improvements are proposed. Students aren't asking for luxury facilities; We ask for something as basic as a space where we can study and concentrate in decent conditions.

one_star_reviews.text: I'm giving one star because I can't give less. The customer service is terrible. Last year I bought a watch, and after only a week of use, the strap started to peel and a piece broke off. After keeping it stored away for a while, because I couldn't wear it like that, I decided to come back and see what they could do. The afternoon sales assistant told me to come back in the morning when the manager was there. The next day I returned, and she took my information to check with customer service. I didn't receive a response, so I decided to email customer service (because they don't take calls, of course). After waiting two weeks, they told me to come to the store with the receipt and the watch, and that they would find a solution. I went back to the store, and the manager told me that customer service had told her the straps weren't covered by the warranty, while I had been told they would find a solution (Case ID: 01737778). It's clear that all they care about is making a sale; they don't care about anything else. For the terrible quality of the watch, I could have bought two or three at any discount store. The manager isn't to blame because she's just following orders. However, they should really review their customer service after the sale, because it's beyond awful. In short, spend €10 more and buy a Casio, because Parfois is rubbish.

They replaced the ropes on my veranda awning in September, and they broke again in July. They told me they give a 6-month warranty. I mean, if you install it almost in the fall, and the awning isn't used much in the winter, what kind of warranty can you give me for three months at most? I asked for a quote, and they quoted me more than last year. They're a bunch of crooks. I don't recommend them; I won't call them again.

How did you respond? The invoice I have is yours; I don't know if it was done by your staff or another company. You also replaced the awning fabric and the ropes a while ago. The conclusion is that I've always said to check things properly, and what they do is what's in the quote. This last quote, which took you more than a month to give me, I suppose is because of your workload. It never says it was an awning inspection; it only says rope replacement. If it had said an awning inspection, I would have paid for it without hesitation. I mean, since they broke less than a year ago, I don't know if it's because it's not the same rope the awning had before. I think the company should be more understanding and look into why they broke so soon.

one_star_reviews.text:
I can't comment on the quality of the services because I didn't have the opportunity to try them, but my experience with customer service was very negative.

I had an appointment booked almost a month in advance through Treatwell, with a payment commitment. Two days prior, at 11:08 PM, I received an email from Treatwell informing me that the center had canceled the booking. At the same time, the center contacted me via WhatsApp to confirm the services, and at 11:29 PM, they told me they expected me for my appointment on Friday, without mentioning the cancellation.

When I saw the cancellation email from Treatwell the following morning, I wrote to them to inquire, and they told me that, according to them, the cancellation was due to a scheduling error and that the appointment had been rescheduled on Treatwell. However, I contacted Treatwell directly, and they confirmed that there was no new booking.

Even accepting their explanation that it was a mistake, I find their handling of the situation incomprehensible. If it had truly been cancelled by mistake, it would have been as simple as sending another WhatsApp message right then and there, since they were already contacting me to confirm I would be attending the appointment. They could have told me they'd made a mistake canceling the booking but that the appointment was still on and there was no problem. They shouldn't have waited until the next day to ask for explanations after receiving a cancellation from Treatwell.

Furthermore, I consider it inappropriate to contact a customer at that hour to manage a booking, and overall, I found the way the whole situation was handled quite strange. Finally, in response to my frustration, they seemed quite eager to cancel the appointment.

I completely understand that mistakes can happen, but what I expected in this case was transparency, a clear explanation, and at least some initiative to resolve the issue. The customer service and booking management left much to be desired, especially considering it was an appointment booked well in advance and with a payment commitment.

How will I know in the future if a package will be returned because they marked me as absent multiple times?

I called customer service, and they confirmed that the delivery driver didn't have time to make the delivery. Otherwise, I would have been convinced they're just liars who don't respect your time, period.

one_star_reviews.text:
Lack of transparency, terrible communication, and mismanagement.

We visited a property and, after requesting basic administrative documentation from the community to ensure everything was in order, we were informed that there was another offer on the table. However, they told us that if we started the reservation process, we could hold the house until they provided us with all the missing information. We agreed to make an offer and process the reservation, provided our details, and were told that the document would be sent to us shortly.

From that moment on, the management was characterized by a complete lack of transparency. They kept us waiting for two full days for a document that never arrived, constantly stalling us with the excuse that the manager was very busy but that it was imminent.

The lack of clarity about what was happening was total. Instead of being transparent, we understand that they used our willingness to reserve as leverage to negotiate behind the scenes with the other interested parties. Today, after repeated communications with the sales representative who told me they would send me the document, the real estate agency's management called to inform me that the house had been sold to another party for a higher price.

It's perfectly understandable that a real estate agency would try to get the highest offer for the property. What is unacceptable is the lack of transparency with the buyers. They kept us waiting, stalling and making us believe we had options for two days, clearly using us as a "plan B" in case the other party didn't increase their offer. All of this without informing us at any point about the actual status of the negotiations, and closing the sale without giving us any room or opportunity to make a counteroffer if necessary.

A disappointing experience that demonstrates their way of managing transactions lacks the clarity and professionalism expected in this type of investment.

one_star_reviews.text:
I don't recommend it. I was there for several months, quite a few. I left exactly the same as when I arrived. The nutritionist was useless; at least in my case, she was a fraud.
She tells you what you have to eat when you clearly don't want to eat, so it's pointless. The psychologist was the same; after months, I don't remember a single conversation that made any sense.
Meanwhile, you go every day, they force you to eat, which I know from experience isn't the solution to anything, because I've also seen my companions make no progress for months. And if you do make progress, it's because you have no other choice, because they punish you if you don't eat.
That's not the way to address the problem. Because in the end, you leave exactly the same as when you arrived. With the same fears about food, but simply trying to escape that place.

I've seen people discharged, usually after a year in there—it's quite a coincidence that it's always a year, as if that's the maximum time you can stay, knowing that the person leaving is going to relapse because their recovery was miraculous.
From one month to the next, they suddenly feel fine with food and are deemed fit to leave. It's a scam.
I left worse than when I arrived. They create insecurities, they make you believe things to weaken you, instead of strengthening you.

Perhaps you don't believe me and think I'm an exaggerated sufferer, but you can try it yourselves. You won't find the solution to your problem there; you'll only waste your life and money.

I don't know how to explain this to anyone looking for a center that can truly help solve an eating disorder. I hope my words help you find another option.

one_star_reviews.text:
Blatant abuse of labor costs and inflated billing.
I took my Renault Mégane in for basic maintenance: oil change, filters, replacement of all four glow plugs, and new rear brake pads. The final bill came to €791.33.
What's outrageous is how they inflate the labor costs: they charged me for 4.72 hours of work (€260 + VAT) for a job that a mechanic takes at most two and a half hours to do. To make matters worse, they charge an additional €40 + VAT for "diagnostics" simply for using the diagnostic machine to clear the fault code, plus the usual markup on parts.

A complete lack of ethics and a total rip-off. There are much more honest workshops in the area. Don't go back if you don't want to be charged for almost five hours of labor for routine maintenance. Keep your wallet safe.

EDIT AFTER THE WORKSHOP'S RESPONSE:
The list of work they detail in their response is exactly the same as the one I provided: oil, 4 filters, 4 glow plugs, and rear brake pads. None of these tasks constitute a complex repair, nor do they justify 4.72 hours of labor (€260 + VAT) for a routine maintenance service. Retracting calipers with an electric brake only takes a few minutes with the machine.
Their argument also fails to justify this labor time by using "checks and diagnostics," when the invoice itself already charges €40 + VAT for the diagnostics separately, in addition to other small items.
The official invoice clearly reflects the figures. The dissatisfaction isn't about not knowing what was done to the car, but about attributing a disproportionate amount of time to quick mechanical interventions.
Price assessment
Overpriced
Services
Air & cabin filter replacement, Auto engine diagnostic, Brakes, Oil change

I'm giving it one star because it won't let me leave it blank, mainly because my car sat in their workshop for 18 months exposed to the elements. I begged them to finish because I needed the vehicle to get around. To top it all off, my car was damaged in their workshop, and by law, their insurance should cover the repairs, but my insurance had to cover it. They inflated the bill, replacing parts I didn't ask for, telling me they still hadn't found the problem. This went on for 18 months. Finally, they gave me the bill without me knowing what it would cost. They charged me €4,618.15 plus €1,100 for a part I paid for separately, which would have been illegal. Besides all that, he told me to pay him under the table (B), which I refuse to do. When it's such a big repair, I want everything documented for my own safety. I had to go to my lawyer, and she advised me to lower the price and reach an agreement with him. When he refused, I had to "threaten" him with the police. I told him, "Okay, I'll pay you everything, I'll take my car, but tomorrow you'll have a registered letter from my lawyer." He said no, so I had to "threaten" him with calling the police. Thanks to his wife, Laura, he lowered the bill by 1500, because if it were up to him, he wouldn't even bother to reach an agreement. I took the vehicle out and as soon as I did, it broke down—a vacuum hose. I had to take it back, and he fixed it. After a week, another problem appeared: a noise from the timing belt, and the CV joint boot was twisted. I took it back, and he fixed the CV joint. The following week, I took it back, he did some tests, and then told me to bring it back on Monday. Well, I left it with him, and he told me the problem was that it didn't have oil pressure. The thing is, the car sat there for over a month waiting for the oil pump to be replaced. Flavio tried to charge me for the oil pump even though the car was still under warranty. I refused, of course. I'd never had that problem before. I brought it in with an issue where it was running on three cylinders, and it turned out he took it out with a completely different problem, and with other issues I'd never had with my car, like the driveshaft. It was a complete nightmare. I wouldn't recommend this garage to anyone. I really should have listened to the people who told me not to take it to Jelicalin. I'm not the only one with bad experiences; they print invoices at the last minute and put whatever they want on them. Luckily, I have my lawyer's support... The moral of the story: terrible service, a rip-off, exorbitant labor costs, and parts not replaced, not to mention the incredibly long wait. They didn't meet the agreed-upon deadlines. After this whole ordeal, the repair isn't even done properly. There's still a noise coming from the timing belt, and I'm praying that no new problems appear.
Zero professionalism.

After taking the car back three times, which I think they were just giving me the runaround, they told me that's how it is and they're not responsible. So I had to file a complaint with the consumer protection agency, Consumobide.

one_star_reviews.text:
The theory was good, but my experience with the practical lessons and paperwork was terrible.

The theory is very good, but my experience with the practical lessons and, especially, with the paperwork was very bad.

One of the biggest problems is the lack of clarity regarding payments. First, they tell you that a procedure costs a certain amount, and then, once you've made the payment, new charges appear because "it was processed incorrectly," "another procedure needs to be done," or "the previous person explained it to you wrong." In some cases, you can end up paying twice for the same procedure. It feels like new fees keep appearing that weren't explained from the beginning.

With the practical lessons, I also think the ratio between the number of classes and the preparation received leaves much to be desired. Besides the fact that I caught the instructor taking more lessons than I had used from my voucher package, you can end up taking a lot of lessons without feeling truly prepared for the exam. In my case, switching to another driving school made a huge difference, and I managed to pass with far fewer lessons.

I also consider certain behaviors during driving lessons completely unacceptable: misogynistic comments, inappropriate remarks about immigration, and political podcasts on the radio. Furthermore, part of the lessons were dedicated to personal conversations, phone calls, or even talking to other people in the vehicle instead of focusing exclusively on the student. If I'm paying for a lesson, I expect to receive that lesson.

Another major problem is the lack of support when any issues arise. I requested a change of instructor precisely because of these circumstances, and even though I made it clear that I wanted to practice with a different instructor before retaking the exam, they ultimately ignored my request. Their response was, "So you wanted to change instructors?" I ended up being sent to the exam without having been able to prepare, neither with another instructor nor with the one I had.

When a problem arose with attending an exam due to an official procedure, I also received no help in finding a solution. I had to contact other driving schools and go there in person to find out what options I had, because here they will always deny that there is a solution when there really is one.

Finally, when I switched driving schools, they had to practically review my application from scratch and request information from the DGT (Spanish Traffic Authority) because the previous process wasn't clear. Furthermore, I hadn't been properly informed about the available timeframes for retaking the exam, something I consider especially important when applying for a driver's license.

Overall, my impression was one of poor communication, a lack of transparency regarding payments, and very little help when a problem arose. In addition, the reception staff often seemed quite unfriendly. Moreover, since the administrative staff member keeps changing, they always use the line, "The previous person explained it incorrectly, but if you don't pay, we can't continue with the process."

The theory is fine, but I personally wouldn't recommend this driving school for practical lessons or for the license application process. Before enrolling, I recommend visiting all the driving schools you can find in person to see their willingness to help and ensure you understand what you're getting into.

one_star_reviews.text: We bought some earrings because my daughter had lost the screw back on a pair we had from El Corte Inglés. We only wanted the screw backs, and Encarna told us they didn't have screw backs for other brands, that they didn't work with the brand, and that we should hurry and put them back in because the piercing closes up quickly. So we asked if we should buy new ones from there or from your store, if they had replacement screw backs in case she lost them again, because they often do. She said yes, because she had lost them. But surprise, when we went there, it was quite busy, so we went with two shopping carts, and the store was packed. I'm not going in. My husband went in, and when it was his turn, they served him quickly (they didn't even try to check if they had them). They just said he had to bring the receipt for the reference number of our earring. They didn't want to bother looking into why a screw back costs around €15. She wasn't very friendly, by the way; she even questioned whether the earring was from there. Don't you know what products you sell? I wasn't asking for it for free. Anyway, my husband left, and seeing how she treated him, I went back inside. After walking around for a bit, I went back in to talk to her. There was no one else inside, and again she asked for the receipt because she didn't know the reference number. I replied that I hadn't brought it, and if I looked, I might have it saved. I told her that when her colleague sold me the earring, she said they had a spare, that I lived in the village and didn't want to go to Valencia. At that time, I already had an earring from another brand, but I bought it again from your store! My response was, "Don't worry, we'll buy another one, or I'll find a solution." But I was indignant when people treat you badly, and that's exactly what happened. €15 in a store in Valencia, where she told me it was an easy earring, just three screw-ons. Without telling her anything about what had happened in your store, I took the earring off, and now I see black in the middle. In short, a disastrous experience. We want to support the stores in our town, but it's difficult like this. We have to learn to treat people better! I know that working with the public isn't easy, but at no point did we disrespect anyone, even if it was just looking for a €15 screw back for the earring we bought in your store previously. Besides, you don't know if that person might be a future customer! We won't be back, and your response that you didn't understand my complaint is something you won't understand! And no thanks, I won't be returning because you didn't even bother to look for the screw back for our earring, the service was completely unpleasant, and the gold earring in the middle has turned black, as you can see in the photo.

one_star_reviews.text:
I took my car in because it wouldn't start, and after waiting three weeks for a response from the garage, they recommended a complete service and battery replacement. After they made the necessary changes and charged me nearly €500, the car had the same problem three days later and wouldn't start. I went back to the garage to demand the warranty due to their poor professional practice and incorrect diagnosis, and they told me the best thing I could do was get rid of the car and that they wouldn't take any responsibility.

Three days after taking it to the garage and being charged €500, they told me they wouldn't accept my vehicle. Therefore, I asked for a refund. Of course, they flatly refused.

I asked for a complaint form, and then David Roldán started yelling like a madman that he was going to sue me (even though I had been very polite the whole time). He started telling me I was talking nonsense and ended up telling me to go to hell.

I reluctantly obtained a complaint form, which will be submitted to the consumer protection agency shortly so that this case of professional negligence doesn't go unpunished.

If you're reading this and it helps, I want to warn you that you'll be dealing with scammers and thugs whose only goal is to squeeze as much money out of you as possible instead of solving your problem. And to you, David Roldán, I expect you to show your face when the time comes, since I saw a comment from another customer who had a similar problem and mentioned that you didn't even have the decency to appear at the arbitrary consumer protection hearing.

one_star_reviews.text:
Terrible experience and a complete lack of professional rigor. They charge €3,000 for a deficient service.

As an education professional, I can affirm that Master D Córdoba's pedagogical methodology leaves much to be desired:

Insubstantial online classes: They are limited to the teachers simply reading slides on a screen. There is no interaction, dynamism, or real added value.

Outdated and erroneous materials: Tests are scarce, repetitive, and riddled with spelling mistakes. When asked for more variety or greater difficulty, the center's response is that "a higher level isn't necessary," when the reality of the official exam is infinitely more demanding.

Negligence in the mock exams: In the final stretch before the official exam, the instructor admitted to not even having read the test because "other teachers created it" and printed psychometric tests in black and white when color discrimination was required to answer.

Lack of transparency: Complete opacity regarding the actual pass rate.

The feeling among the students I've spoken with is one of widespread dissatisfaction and a sense of abandonment. I absolutely do not recommend investing time or money in this center.

one_star_reviews.text: Hello, I'll be clear. I don't usually write much, but in this case, I will. I went to the occupational health clinic not because I was fine, but because I had a fall. The day before, I went to the emergency room at Castilla del Pino, and the next day I went to the clinic as my employer requested. I fell in the bathroom, putting all my weight on my left foot. When the doctor asked if I was allergic to any medication, I said no. She asked if I had any illnesses, and I said yes, one of them being fibromyalgia. I'm sure the doctor who treated me based her assessment on my fibromyalgia, but that's not how it works. If they're specialists, they should realize that you don't fall with fibromyalgia, and you don't go to a place where the care was terrible for no reason. I was in pain and couldn't put weight on my foot. At Castilla del Pino, they told me I had a small fracture and a sprained ankle. I believe the doctor who evaluated me used fibromyalgia as a pretext, which shouldn't be the case. I care for a very old and strong grandfather. I suffer from Alzheimer's and, as a home caregiver, they should have the sense that I can't work like this. I pray to God that I don't fall again or that nothing serious happens to me because, as a mutual insurance company, they're supposedly there to help, not disappoint people. They sent me away with a report telling me to go to my family doctor so she could give me sick leave, which I won't do because I see that it wasn't the right thing to do...
I had a bad experience today with the saleswoman; she was constantly yelling. She was rude, acting like you're there to buy something, not to beg. She had absolutely no customer service skills.

one_star_reviews.text:
We purchased a machine from Autopulit and requested the required driver/software to operate it. Despite purchasing through the official distributor in Turkey, we initially received no response or support.

After some time, the support team finally contacted us stating they were working on a solution, and shortly after, they provided the required software files. However, during our initial evaluation, we found that we were still unable to operate the machine. The provided files were not a standard setup package, but rather a Windows XP system backup. Although we successfully restored the backup, we could not establish control over the machine. Due to a very high workload at our factory, we couldn't allocate more time to this issue right at that moment.

Months later, our final status remains exactly the same: Despite all technical attempts throughout this long process, we have been completely unable to get the machine running. The Windows XP backup is restored and the software opens, but no commands are being transmitted to the machine. Technical checks performed by our team have conclusively confirmed that there are no mechanical, electronic, or hardware issues. The problem is entirely software-related, stemming from the failure to deploy the correct driver/software infrastructure. Unfortunately, it appears the necessary technical capacity to resolve this issue is lacking on their end.

As a manufacturer, it deeply saddens us that such a high-quality machine with great potential is left completely idle—essentially going to waste—solely because proper software support cannot be provided. Due to our belief in the machine's build quality, we still want to hold onto the hope that a solution will be found at some point; however, this prolonged process and their after-sales support have unfortunately been a major disappointment.

I don't usually leave negative reviews, but I feel it's necessary this time.

I paid €220 for an official software update for my Nissan X-Trail. It's only been 7 months and barely 3,000 km, and the vehicle has the exact same problem.

The worst part came when I complained: the company says they can't tell me which software version they installed because the computer where they stored the data broke down and they replaced it, so they don't keep any records.

As if that weren't enough, they tell me that if I want to know which version the car has or which one should be installed now, I have to pay again. In other words, they can't tell me what they charged me for 7 months ago or what they're going to install now. What if they install the same version again and the problem persists?

Frankly, I find it unacceptable that a company that charges for this type of work has no record of the operations it performs and doesn't offer even a minimal solution to the customer.

I'm very disappointed with this company.

The dealership took my Nissan X-Trail to this company for an official software update, which cost €220. Only seven months and about 3,000 km have passed, and the car is experiencing the exact same problem again.

When I tried to get clarification, the company's response was that they couldn't tell me which software version they installed because the computer where they kept the records broke down and had to be replaced.

And the most surprising thing: if we want to know which version the car has or which one should be installed now, we have to pay again.

For €220, I expected more professionalism and, above all, a minimum of traceability for the work performed.

one_star_reviews.text:
I entered the shop with my two daughters, aged four and ten. They were checking a toy. The eldest daughter removed a sticker from the toy to demonstrate its workings to her younger sister. She then placed it back the toy with  the sticker . Suddenly, a seller approached her rudely, demanding payment and accusing her of miss using the toys . I was just three steps  away, getting some sunscreen, and returned to pay when I found my daughter crying.

Firstly, let’s consider the context. This is a shop in the airport where children come to see, and maybe if something gets their attention to buy  a  toy. She didn’t break anything; she didn’t remove it from a package, she did not brake it and she wasn’t alone for more than five minutes. Couldn’t the seller have waited a moment and approached me to explain what was happening? Instead, it was easier to come and make a child cry and accuse me of not educating my daughter properly. Seriously?  Please lady  change jobs because we’re customers with children in the airport’s kids’ section, and they didn’t exhibit inappropriate behaviour.

Please avoid coming to the duty-free shop, El Merecido. Give your money to someone else.

To the lady who intervened and said nothing happened:

Yes, nothing happened. I agree that nothing happened that I couldn’t have apologised for, paid for the toy, or adhered to the shop’s policy. But why did it happen? What happened is a bad experience and unnecessary use of power from an adult to a children…

To the male manager or colleague that talked to my daughter and tried to calm her …. thanks for your attention to us and kindness….

one_star_reviews.text:
Very negative experience with this workshop
I sold a headlight on Wallapop for €340 to be installed on a customer's car.
The buyer opened a claim saying the headlight wasn't working and sent me a video comparing his headlight and mine, showing that they were supposedly in the same condition.
The problem came later: when Wallapop processed the return, the headlight I received wasn't the one I had sent. It was the headlight shown in the video as belonging to his vehicle. The information visible in the photos, such as the manufacturing date and part numbers, allows for identification of the parts, and they don't match those of my original headlight.
I've tried to contact David Martínez several times, both on his personal phone and by calling the workshop. I haven't received a response to my WhatsApp messages for two days, and they aren't answering my calls either.
I find this an absolutely unacceptable way to handle a problem. If there's a discrepancy about a part, the least they can do is return the exact same part that was received.

I'm documenting my experience so other sellers and customers know how my case was handled. For a small business, losing a part valued at €340 in this way represents a significant loss.

Update: After publishing this review, the workshop finally responded through this same channel, stating that they still haven't received "their" headlight and that's why they haven't returned mine.

I want to clarify that I never accepted that headlight, precisely because it wasn't the one I had sent. The delivery was refused, and the package remained with the shipping company. Therefore, I don't have any of their headlights that I can return.

If the postal service hasn't delivered the headlight you're expecting, you should file a claim with the carrier. I don't think it's reasonable to hold me responsible for a part I never accepted or had in my possession, nor to make the return of my €340 conditional on them recovering a part I rejected.

After almost three weeks of trying to resolve the issue, it is especially disappointing that the first communication I receive is only after posting a review.

one_star_reviews.text:
I just went to the post office and the experience was beyond regrettable. I wanted to take a simple photo of my package with the shipping label to prove it had been delivered and sent correctly, but the employee refused, citing a supposed "company policy" which, when we asked her to show it to us, neither she nor her supervisor (the one who calls herself the head of the section for the offices in Vilagarcía, Cambados, etc.) could locate. The employee claimed that she had studied for the civil service exam many years ago (her exact words) and that the post office didn't have a Official State Gazette (BOE). Unbelievable. The policy hasn't turned up anywhere.
Zero transparency.

Given our dissatisfaction, we asked for a complaint form and, at first, they also tried to prevent us from getting one. Their response was, "Why do you want it?" We were dumbfounded.

They finally delivered it, but we even had to insist to get our receipt, something basic in any claim, since they said, "That's it, right? You can leave." It was as if they'd forgotten to give us the receipt; we think they wouldn't tear it up and throw it away if we left without it... something smells fishy.

The most worrying thing was the attitude we received throughout the entire process, even going so far as to tell us that our request was due to a supposed "buyer's distrust." For our part, if we ask for proof of delivery, it's precisely because we also have no reason to blindly trust that the package will arrive correctly after so many experiences and dealings with numerous shipments and delivery drivers from this same company, Correos (the Spanish postal service), since there are thousands of employees. We don't fully trust any of them because their profiles are so varied.

If there really is a regulation prohibiting photographing the package once it's delivered, they should be able to show it to the customer clearly and without excuses. The regulations could be located in just a few minutes without any obstacles, neither from her nor her supervisor, who claims not to know where she is at that moment.

And if a customer requests a complaint form because they are dissatisfied with the service, they shouldn't encounter any impediments, as they have the right to obtain one, whatever the problem. We see in previous reviews that they have already denied it to other people; it must be a habit of the employee at this office.

one_star_reviews.text:
I’m genuinely disappointed to be writing this review because our family has shopped at Koala Bay in Torrevieja for years.

We visit this part of Spain every couple of years and Koala Bay has always been one of the shops we make a point of visiting. We still own and wear items bought around 8 years ago because the quality has always been excellent, and during this holiday alone we spent around €160–€180 in the Torrevieja Puerto store just a couple of days before this incident.

That visit was lovely, with friendly and patient staff.

Unfortunately, when we returned with our 12-year-old daughter so she could buy some bracelets for her friends, the experience was completely different.

My daughter initially thought she had found the same bracelet she had previously bought. Once the security tags were removed and she could look more closely, she realised they were slightly different. She politely asked if there were any others available and, when there weren’t, we decided to buy all three of the similar ones instead so she and her friends could have matching bracelets.

From that point, the member of staff’s attitude changed completely.

She huffed, abruptly/snatched and took the bracelets from my daughter’s hands, walked to the till and became very cold and hostile. At the till she was muttering in Spanish under her breath and then gave the total so quickly that my daughter did not understand.

My daughter asked her to repeat the amount, even trying to use Spanish herself, and the assistant responded sternly and rolled her eyes at her.

My daughter was visibly upset.

Our Spanish is limited because we are holidaymakers, but we always try. Please and thank you matter hugely to us, our children are trying to learn Spanish, and only two evenings earlier my daughter had happily been practising Spanish with other staff in the same shop because they were patient and encouraging.

There is a big difference between someone not speaking your language fluently and someone being disrespectful.

I want to be completely fair: by this point my daughter became angry and threw the money onto the counter. I immediately told her afterwards that this was not acceptable and that we do not respond to poor behaviour with poor behaviour ourselves.

But she is 12.

She had just had items snatched from her hands, been spoken to harshly, had someone roll their eyes at her because she did not understand the amount, and had been made to feel embarrassed and unwelcome.

If this had happened to me as an adult, I probably would have walked away, assumed somebody was having a bad day and thought no more of it.

But I cannot overlook an adult treating a child that way.

I worked in retail myself for years, so I understand that staff have difficult days and difficult customers. We were not being difficult. We were trying to buy three bracelets.

We work hard for the money we spend on our holidays and I do not expect special treatment because we are customers, but I do expect basic courtesy — particularly towards a child.

What makes this more disappointing is that I contacted Koala Bay directly first and explained everything in detail, giving them the opportunity to address the situation privately. I have received no response.

I would not normally take something like this to Google or TripAdvisor, but having given the company the opportunity to respond, I feel other families should be aware of our experience.

I will be adding photographs of some of the older Koala Bay items we still own alongside purchases from this holiday, because I want to make clear that this review is not coming from somebody who visited once and decided they disliked the shop. We genuinely have been loyal customers and have loved the brand for years.

That is why this is such a shame.

One member of staff’s behaviour, followed by no response from the company, has completely changed how we feel about returning.

A terrible experience, and a company I would never trust again.

one_star_reviews.text:
I think it's a disgrace that they're handing out fines left and right every afternoon on the beaches in this area just because two wheels are on the asphalt without obstructing traffic. In the area where I was fined, there were no signs 100 meters past the roundabout (they fined more than 40 people). Get to work and improve traffic flow at roundabout exits and intersections. It seems you prefer to collect money for the whole year rather than do your job.

By the way, if the opposition sees this, why aren't they penalizing the parking attendants who control the parking and allow people to park in wooded areas, creating a fire risk due to the heat from exhaust fumes and catalytic converters? This is on record, and the day something happens, they'll have to explain why they're operating without any permits.

The residents' area of ​​A Illa de Arousa is a disgrace. The street that leads you from the beaches and one of the most visited areas ends directly at the start of the video-monitored zone. By the time you realize what's happening, you're already on this street, and three weeks later you receive a €200 fine. The revenue-raising motive is clear.
There are other, more effective measures that could be taken, such as installing bollards that raise and lower, like those in other towns such as Santiago de Compostela. I feel very sorry for the residents and businesses of A Illa de Arousa, but this is going to have consequences. I, for one, don't plan on going back for a while, even though I really enjoy spending the day there and eating in the wonderful restaurants, which are not to blame for the revenue-driven measures of their policies. Thank you very much and best regards.

I took the car back a second time, they repaired the gap, but the door was still slightly misaligned. I haven't taken it back since.

Months later, I noticed that the new tailgate's heated window didn't have all the filaments working, and they painted the tailgate a different color. Of course, the repair warranty had already expired since I noticed these things too late. That's why my experience with them hasn't been very good.

one_star_reviews.text: We purchased two bicycles. When we removed them from the transport box, we realized they were essentially children's bikes. The handlebars and saddle cannot be adjusted to a low enough height. Overall, the folding bikes seem unstable and not sturdy enough for adults weighing approximately 90 kg. These reasons led us to return the bicycles. As we prepared the return shipment, the supplier informed us that we could only return the bicycles if they remained in the transport box. However, we only noticed the unstable nature of the bikes, with their limited height adjustment, when they were already outside the box. It is obvious that the supplier deliberately formulated the return policy in such a way as to make a return and refund practically impossible. Despite the fact that we hadn't ridden the bicycles a single meter, our return request was rejected. We feel cheated and believe this business practice is unethical and extremely customer-unfriendly. We certainly cannot recommend such a company. We hope many people read this review to avoid financial losses and personal humiliation. We feel completely unjustly treated. We bought the bikes in good faith, paid immediately, and then experienced this disappointment. Never again Soluciones Tecnicas 2000 S.L.!!!

one_star_reviews.text:
If I could give 0 stars, I absolutely would.

We booked the excursion in advance and specifically came here by taxi because we live almost 2 hours away. And after all that, they simply REFUSED TO LET US JOIN THE EXCURSION.
Nobody warned us that there were any special requirements regarding footwear or clothing. There was absolutely no information about this in the booking or anywhere else. It was +35°C outside, so we came wearing sandals which, honestly, seems completely reasonable in that heat.
Instead of simply explaining the rules, a woman came out and started speaking to us extremely aggressively. She was standing literally inches away from us and almost shouting, saying that it was “not her problem” that we were wearing sandals. She even started comparing us to some German tourists who apparently came a few days earlier wearing trainers.
We explained that in our country we had ridden horses before wearing flip-flops and had never had any problems. But instead of calmly explaining the rules or trying to find any solution, she just shouted at us and blamed us for “not dressing properly.”
AND THE WORST PART they simply refused to let us go on the excursion.
We spent money on a taxi, spent hours travelling there, had a reservation — and in the end we got nothing except extremely rude treatment.
This is an absolutely horrible way to treat customers. If you have specific clothing or footwear requirements, YOU NEED TO INFORM YOUR CUSTOMERS PROPERLY BEFORE THEY ARRIVE, not tell them about it after they have already travelled for two hours.
What makes this even more unacceptable is not even the rule itself, but the WAY we were treated. Aggression, blaming us and absolutely no attempt to find a solution.
After this experience, I absolutely DO NOT RECOMMEND this place. If you care about being treated with basic respect and decency, spend your money somewhere else.

Honestly, I deeply regret coming here in the first place.

stay away from this place.

I have completed 12 Austro exams, I have been here for two years, and I still haven’t been able to do my solo flight.
So please, if you are thinking about coming here, do your research and think very carefully before giving them your money.

Good evening: I am writing to you to file a complaint. I purchased a mechanism for my swimming pool from you on January 29, 2025, for which I paid €668.62. This mechanism began to malfunction on September 8, 2026. We have tried repeatedly to contact you, but it has been impossible. You only replied to an email stating that this product has a one-month warranty, which I find absolutely unbelievable for a defective and poor-quality product. I strongly recommend that anyone considering purchasing from you should consider a different brand, as your lack of responsibility in addressing your product issues leaves much to be desired. Furthermore, I will be filing a complaint with the consumer protection office and pursuing all available legal avenues.

In response to your reply, I want to say that the company that installed it did a good job. There's a defect in a rubber seal that's broken, and that's a defect in your product. My pool is regularly maintained and is in very good condition. You're the ones who manufactured a poor-quality product, but of course, if you only offer a one-month warranty, it's no surprise. I just hope this serves as a warning to others about how things work and prevents them from making the same mistake I did.

And the saddest part of all is that you won't even take responsibility, and I have to resort to this.

I'm giving them 1 star because I can't give them 0.
Terrible service. They were supposed to deliver an Amazon package to Ayódar and they didn't meet the delivery deadline. After several complaints, phone calls (which they didn't answer), emails (which they replied to several days late and without offering any solutions), ... they finally left the package in Castellón, 36 km from our house, which is about a 50-minute drive. And the same amount of time to get back.

According to the package tracking on the Paack app, they came to our house twice and couldn't find us. But that was a lie, because neither of those days did we leave the house between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM (which was the extended delivery window according to the message we received from Paack). In other words, they're liars and they DIDN'T COME to our house. And they don't come because it's a small village in the mountains, which you have to reach by taking a special mountain road.

Paack, if you're not interested in these kinds of services in rural Spain, don't order them, but don't mess things up for us end users.
In the end, I had to buy the product again and use a different delivery address, in more populated Spain.

one_star_reviews.text: It gets worse every year. Less cleanliness in all areas, floors torn up, figures stolen, pews smashed. The only good thing I can say is that they no longer leave the holes empty; they fill them in, which is fantastic because it looked awful. But it was shameful when I saw all those crucifixes ripped out. I think we pay enough, since we're practically begging our relatives to maintain everything in this state for 99 years. It scares me to think what it will be like in another 20 years...

I find the state of the cemetery deplorable. It's very pretty at the entrance, but the sections are full of fallen leaves, open niches, and filthy, giving an impression of neglect. The interior lawns are dry.
The restrooms are abandoned, uncleaned for years, with no toilet paper or anything to dry your hands, and the tiles are covered in 3 kg of dust.
It's a disaster. I would like to remind the city council that we already pay enough to ensure that the cemetery where our loved ones rest is clean and well-maintained.

The state of the cemetery is shameful.
No matter how many complaints we file, those in charge allow and condone the deplorable condition of our loved ones' graves and their final resting place.
They simply agree with us, but take no action and fail to enforce the established rules and regulations.
What good are complaints if, after acknowledging our innocence, everything remains the same?
Our loved ones and their families deserve respect, dignity, and proper maintenance. This neglect has to stop.

Very bad experience

The condition of this area of ​​the cemetery is deplorable. In certain areas, especially where there are recent burials, there is a very strong and unpleasant odor, apparently coming from the niches, which is almost unbearable.

I understand that a cemetery is a place where certain odors may exist, but the intensity we experienced seems excessive and worrying. We believe that an investigation should be conducted to determine if there are any problems with the niches, the ventilation, or the facilities.

I believe that, out of respect for the deceased and their families, these situations should be reviewed and resolved as soon as possible. We hope that the cemetery will take action in this regard.

I never expected to have to do this, but my experience with this company has been terrible, and I absolutely cannot recommend them.
I hired them to apply an anti-crack acrylic coating to the entire exterior of my house and install LED spotlights. Very quickly, defects began to appear: the paint peeled in several areas, and some spotlights stopped working, demonstrating a level of workmanship far below what one would expect from professionals.
The most outrageous thing wasn't the damage itself, but their subsequent attitude. After visiting my home, personally verifying all the flaws, and acknowledging that the work was poor and promising to repair them, they refused to repair the paint. In other words, when it came time to take responsibility, they simply didn't fulfill their obligations.

A reputable company stands behind the work it performs and takes responsibility for its mistakes when they occur. In this case, they chose to completely wash their hands of the client, forcing me to find other solutions, despite having paid for work that should have been guaranteed. My experience has been with a company that does not take responsibility for the quality of its work or for the commitments made to its clients.

Very bad experience at this hardware store.

I bought several products, including some batteries and screws. When I left the store, I accidentally forgot to take the battery pack that I had already paid for and left it on the counter.

About 40-60 minutes later I went back to pick it up. The salesperson told me that he didn't know what had happened to the batteries and that since a lot of people had passed by, maybe someone had taken them.

However, I found it very strange because I saw that in the place where the salesperson had originally taken the batteries, there was another identical pack. I had the clear impression that they had simply put it back in its place.

The salesperson did not return the batteries to me nor did he offer to check the cameras to clarify what had happened.

I left with a very unpleasant feeling and feeling cheated. I think that, in a situation like this, the least they could have done would have been to check the cameras or find a solution for a customer who had paid for the product. Based on my experience, I do not recommend this establishment.

Nowhere is it clearly explained that store wallet funds cannot be refunded back to the original payment method.

​We purchased cycling shorts, but the sizing was off, so we returned them and selected the wallet refund option because we fully intended to buy from them again. However, the second pair we ordered using the wallet balance was completely unacceptable—the fabric was way too thin and totally see-through.

​We wanted to return them and simply get our money back instead of ordering again, but they refused, claiming that funds converted to wallet credit can never be refunded to a bank account. This is completely unfair. To make matters worse, when we tried to resolve this via email, customer support just replied that they couldn't understand what we were saying. Selling globally without competent English customer support is simply unacceptable.

one_star_reviews.text:
On my second cleaning booking, the wrong apartment – ​​one floor below – was accidentally cleaned. When I arrived for my vacation, looking forward to a relaxing start, I discovered that my apartment hadn't been cleaned. Instead, I spent about four hours cleaning it before I could even begin to enjoy my holiday. A terrible start to my vacation.

For the next booking, Perfect Clean briefly visited the apartment on Thursday and, as far as I could tell, only made the beds. No other cleaning was done. The actual cleaning was scheduled for Friday.

However, since I received no written confirmation or any feedback despite multiple written inquiries, and the company was no longer reachable by phone, I had to assume that the agreed-upon cleaning would not take place. Therefore, I hired another cleaning service at short notice.

This service cleaned the apartment much more thoroughly and at a significantly better price.

What is particularly disappointing is that my multiple emails requesting a corrected invoice to reflect the actual services provided have gone completely unanswered. The old invoice is simply emailed to me again and again without any explanation.


If an order can be accepted, declined, or cannot be carried out, a brief cancellation would be the bare minimum. Simply not responding is not good customer service in my opinion.

It's a shame, because I used to be reasonably satisfied with Perfect Clean. However, at those prices, I also expect appropriate communication, reliability, and proper execution of the agreed-upon services.

My neighbor told me the same thing.

I am a U.S. dentist who purchased an OXO camera in October 2025 through the U.S. distribution channel associated with ExamVision/Amergo/Clarimed, for approximately $4,000.

From the beginning, the camera did not work reliably in my clinical environment. I experienced repeated Wi‑Fi connection failures between the camera and its phone app, as well as inconsistent SD-card recognition despite using recommended cards. The product was not usable for its intended professional purpose.

I communicated extensively with the U.S. dealer and copied Akura distribution team on the correspondence. Although technical support was promised, I did not receive a meaningful technical resolution, replacement, or refund.

I returned the camera in February 2026 at the dealer’s request. Despite the return and written confirmation for a refund, I have not received it.

My experience with the OXO camera, its Spanish and U.S. sales channel, and the support/refund process has been extremely disappointing

A real joke. Thermor thermos only 2 years old and already broken. Sanimamp washes its hands and rejects the warranty claiming that “the hardness of the water in Barcelona” has damaged it. Oh, we have an anti-limescale filter installed at home!!!

If this thermos can’t handle the water in the area, why do they sell it and install it without warning? Do we have to buy a new thermos every two years? Where is the sustainability?

Lamentable quality, terrible technical service and zero responsibility. A purchase to forget and a company that I absolutely do not recommend to anyone. Feeling of total scam.
Price assessment
Overpriced
Services
Service not listed

A terrible experience with SANIMAMP's technical service.

We had a scheduled visit today from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. My partner and I had to rearrange our work and lose the entire morning to be at home waiting for the technician.

After waiting almost three hours, at 12:40 PM I called myself to remind them that the address on the confirmation email was incorrect, something I had already reported by phone twice before.

It was then, just 20 minutes before the end of the agreed-upon time slot, that they told me the technician was NOT coming. No one had called to let us know. If I hadn't called, I don't know when they planned to tell us.

But even worse was the service I received from Cristina Gallego. In a situation like this, I expected at least an apology and an attempt to find a solution. Instead, her attitude was cold, arrogant, and surprisingly lacking in empathy. Basically, the response was that the technician wasn't coming, that nothing could be done, and that we had to accept it.

We're without air conditioning in the middle of summer and without hot water. Despite explaining the situation, the solution they offered was to wait two more days, until Friday from 9:00 to 11:00. Not this afternoon, nor tomorrow, even though they were the ones who failed to show up for today's visit.

A company can have an issue with a technician. What's difficult to accept is not notifying the customer, making them lose an entire morning and part of their workday, and then, when they call to ask for an explanation, being treated without the slightest empathy or willingness to solve the problem.

Given that this is a technical service that works for LG, I expected a very different level of professionalism and customer service.

I have filed a formal complaint and I hope that SANIMAMP and LG will review what happened.

I wouldn’t recommend this school for nothing, there are much better international school options in Valencia.
